title: Wendelstein 7-X – from concept to reality
summary: A CAD-based animation from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics showing how the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator is configured and what its fusion research aims to achieve. It runs about 11 minutes.
why: HN links it in stellarator and fusion threads as an understandable look at the design and engineering challenges.

quote.text: This video explains the elements quite in an understandable way
